# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For TutorConnect admin UI, use the existing primary gradient theme rather than a black navbar, and avoid duplicating the signed-in identity and user-site link in the global admin navigation when they are already shown on the dashboard.
- For TutorConnect code, prefer the simplest explicit syntax in controllers, views, repositories, and services, even if it requires more lines. Avoid unfamiliar constructs like nameof-based conditional assignment and route tag-helper values such as asp-route-returnTo when a clearer pattern is available; follow existing project styles. Prefer simple, explicit C# code that follows existing repository/controller style; avoid helper methods and abstractions when their behavior is hard to understand, and use direct inline checks where practical.
- When legacy database values have been corrected manually, preserve strict IsActive == "Active" filtering rather than treating NULL as active; retain nullable entity properties when the database column allows NULL.
